package_name: Managed Environments, DLP & Pipelines Foundation Hardening
purpose: Establish the governed Power Platform operating boundary and deployment pathway for JM1 before additional Microsoft-native workloads are operationalized.
deployment_scope: Power Platform solution deployment model; no production proof forced while pipelines are unavailable.
solution_scope: Current JM1 Dataverse solutions observed through PAC.
tenant_admin_boundaries: No destructive or tenant-wide DLP/Managed Environment changes without full impact proof.
rollback_principles: Use managed solution prior version where available; otherwise use source-controlled export/import, Git revert/redeploy for website dependencies, and documented emergency reconciliation.
closeout_criteria: Architecture finalized; admin/pipeline/DLP holds documented; next package gated.
